title: specialist-ensembles: Specialist Ensembles for Cost-Sensitive Imbalanced Classification
description: Code and results for the manuscript 'Specialist Ensembles for Cost-Sensitive Imbalanced Classification: When Detecting Minority Cases Matters Most' (under review at Information Sciences). Includes the ASE/DSS implementations, all baselines (SMOTEBoost, RUSBoost, EasyEnsemble, BalancedBagging, Random Balance, Self-Paced Ensemble, threshold-moving), the equal-budget tuning harness with published grids, the cost-weighted and ratio-matched stacking combiners, and precomputed results for every table in the paper.

creators.name: Parra Ortiz, Francisco
creators.affiliation: Department of Informatics Engineering, Universidad de Santiago de Chile (USACH)
